title: Police video call पर arrest नहीं करती
look: illustrated story (brand/story.js, brand/scenes.js), my face and body as the main character (brand/face, brand/body.js)
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short true-to-life story and then gives you clear advice. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) public advisory, as reported by Deccan Herald and The Tribune: 'CBI/Police/Custom/ED/Judges DO NOT arrest you on video call'; report at helpline 1930 or www.cybercrime.gov.in

sentences: आंटी दस लाख रुपये भेजने ही वाली थीं।
वर्दी में एक आदमी बोला, आपके parcel में drugs मिले हैं।
आप digital arrest में हैं, camera बंद मत करना।
Police, CBI या कोई भी agency, video call पर arrest नहीं करती।
ऐसा call आए तो तीन काम करो।
Phone काटो, पैसे मत भेजो, और एक नौ तीन शून्य पर call करो।
आंटी के दस लाख बच गए।
यह reel अभी मम्मी-पापा को भेजो।
